summary: Taseko Mines Ltd filed a Form 6-K on May 26, 2026, furnishing its Notice and Access Notification and Management Information Circular for the Annual General Meeting of Shareholders scheduled for June 24, 2026. The circular covers routine matters: setting board size, electing directors, appointing auditors, a resolution to change the company name to 'Trekor Metals Limited', approving an amended deferred share unit plan, and an advisory say-on-pay vote. No special situation event—tender offer, acquisition, divestiture, or activist campaign—is disclosed. This is a routine proxy circular filed under cover of Form 6-K by a foreign private issuer, with no deal terms or transactional elements.
